cards.name: Dark Ampharos
cards.description: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

cards.name: Dark Typhlosion
cards.description: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
cards.description: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

cards.name: Shining Charizard
cards.description: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

cards.name: Shining Kabutops
cards.description: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

cards.name: Shining Mewtwo
cards.description: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

cards.name: Dark Tyranitar
cards.description: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

cards.name: Shining Noctowl
cards.description: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

cards.name: Shining Raichu
cards.description: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

cards.name: Shining Steelix
cards.description: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Shining Tyranitar
cards.description: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

cards.name: Light Arcanine
cards.description: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

cards.name: Light Azumarill
cards.description: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

cards.name: Light Dragonite
cards.description: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

cards.name: Light Togetic
cards.description: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

cards.name: Dark Ariados
cards.description: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

cards.name: Dark Magcargo
cards.description: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

cards.name: Dark Omastar
cards.description: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

cards.name: Dark Crobat
cards.description: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

cards.name: Dark Slowking
cards.description: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

cards.name: Dark Ursaring
cards.description: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Light Dragonair
cards.description: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

cards.name: Light Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

cards.name: Light Ledian
cards.description: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

cards.name: Light Machamp
cards.description: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

cards.name: Light Piloswine
cards.description: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

cards.name: Unown [G]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [H]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [W]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Dark Donphan
cards.description: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

cards.name: Unown [X]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

cards.name: Dark Croconaw
cards.description: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

cards.name: Dark Exeggutor
cards.description: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

cards.name: Dark Flaaffy
cards.description: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

cards.name: Dark Forretress
cards.description: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

cards.name: Dark Haunter
cards.description: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

cards.name: Dark Omanyte
cards.description: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

cards.name: Dark Pupitar
cards.description: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

cards.name: Dark Quilava
cards.description: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

cards.name: Dark Espeon
cards.description: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

cards.name: Dark Wigglytuff
cards.description: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

cards.name: Light Dewgong
cards.description: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

cards.name: Light Flareon
cards.description: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

cards.name: Light Golduck
cards.description: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

cards.name: Light Jolteon
cards.description: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

cards.name: Light Machoke
cards.description: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

cards.name: Dark Feraligatr
cards.description: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

cards.name: Light Ninetales
cards.description: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

cards.name: Light Slowbro
cards.description: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

cards.name: Light Vaporeon
cards.description: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

cards.name: Light Venomoth
cards.description: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

cards.name: Light Wigglytuff
cards.description: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

cards.name: Unown [C]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [P]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [Q]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Dark Gengar
cards.description: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

cards.name: Unown [Z]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

cards.name: Dark Octillery
cards.description: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

cards.name: Dark Houndoom
cards.description: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

cards.name: Light Sunflora
cards.description: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

cards.name: Dark Porygon2
cards.description: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

cards.name: Unown [L]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [S]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [T]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [V]
cards.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Dark Scizor
cards.description: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.
